title: The Tractus Protection Register
governing_principle: Nothing built within GEEHUB should have to disappear for something new to become possible.

controls.title: Changed-file integrity gate
controls.scope: Changed repository text and JSON files are checked for malformed JSON, unsafe paths, protected-record deletion, and common credential patterns.
limitations: This is a targeted pattern scan, not a comprehensive secret scanner.
It does not enforce branch protection or replace human review.

controls.title: Repository recovery snapshots
controls.scope: Snapshot manifests record a source commit, file sizes, SHA-256 digests, Git blob hashes, and a manifest self-checksum; restore defaults to a separate directory and refuses overwrite.
limitations: The historical baseline uses Git blob hashes and byte lengths; new snapshots add SHA-256.
A snapshot stored in this repository is not an independent backup.

controls.title: Cross-system recovery index
controls.scope: A machine-readable index connects repository revisions, artifact identity, recovery manifests, Dropbox snapshot metadata, and restoration evidence.
limitations: The recorded Dropbox inventory compared paths, object types, and sizes, not content hashes.
The Dropbox copy is in the same account and is not independent or offline.

controls.title: Shared event inscription
controls.scope: Occurrences receive stable IDs and are appended to the shared activity stream under a process lock; conflicting reuse of an event ID is rejected.
limitations: Derived artifact and outbox projections are maintained alongside the event stream; this control does not by itself make every repository file immutable.

controls.title: Canon version provenance
controls.scope: Canon revisions use linked version records and explicit promotion evidence; experiments do not become canon through repetition or storage alone.
limitations: The version ledger and promotion workflow have their own acceptance checks; this register does not claim every historical record has been migrated.

controls.title: Main-branch review rules
controls.scope: Require reviewed pull requests and the protection-gates status check; prevent force pushes and branch deletion.
limitations: Repository settings were inspected as unprotected in the architecture record. A repository administrator must enable the ruleset.

controls.title: Independent backup and restoration drill
controls.scope: Maintain an independently administered or offline copy and demonstrate restoration into a separate destination.
limitations: The existing Dropbox snapshot is in the same account; content hashes and a real Dropbox restore drill remain outstanding.

controls.title: Outbound publication review
controls.scope: Before publication or external delivery, inspect destination, access level, included content, embedded metadata, and explicit release authority.
limitations: The policy is documented; a general programmatic publication gate is not yet established.

controls.title: Protection register validation
controls.scope: A repository-local validator checks control identity, status vocabulary, evidence-path existence, path containment, and the evidence required by each assurance state; CI runs its regression suite and the validator.
limitations: The GitHub connector can write repository files but cannot execute the Python test suite in this session; CI is configured to run it on the next qualifying workflow event.
